# Anuprerna

> Handwoven artisanal textiles — custom natural-fibre fabric, apparel, accessories and
> homeware — sourced directly from East India's handloom artisans, with production
> traceability and verified artisan-income impact.

Anuprerna manufactures and supplies handloom fabric and finished goods made by 500+
artisans across 30 clusters in West Bengal, Odisha, Jharkhand, Assam and Jaipur, India.
Founded in 2019. The catalogue is roughly 97% handwoven fabric and 3% finished goods
(apparel, home textiles, accessories).

## Who this is for

- Independent fashion designers and couture houses who need unique handwoven cloth,
  full customisation (weave, dye, print), and provenance a mill cannot replicate.
- Sustainable and ethical fashion labels who need verifiable artisan-income and
  fair-wage claims to back their own sustainability marketing — not just copy.
- Indie fabric retailers and craft-led lifestyle/homeware brands who need consistent
  quality and reliable reorders from an organised artisan network, not one weaver.
- Export and bulk buyers who need scaled custom or bulk production with quality control.

Anuprerna is a B2B wholesale supplier and manufacturer first (custom handloom fabric at
low minimum order quantities); it also operates a smaller B2C storefront for direct
retail purchase of handwoven fabric and finished goods.

## What makes it different

- ArtisanFlow: order-level production traceability, so a buyer can track their order
  from fibre to finished product.
- Verified impact: an independent 60 Decibels study of Anuprerna's artisan network found
  an NPS of 67, roughly 9 in 10 artisans reporting improved work, and 43% reporting
  higher income.
- Custom handloom fabric at low MOQ — a gap mills cannot fill and unmanaged direct-weaver
  sourcing cannot fill reliably.
- 100% natural fibres, 22 natural vegetable-dye shades, GOTS azo-free dyeing, roughly 30%
  less energy per metre than power-loom production, and a recycled Khesh line.
- A managed alliance of 500+ artisans across 30 clusters, giving buyers repeatable supply
  instead of a single unreliable weaver relationship.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://anuprerna.com/): overview of the brand and catalogue.
- [Fabric catalogue](https://anuprerna.com/products/fabric): handwoven fabric by craft,
  material, colour and pattern.
- [Finished products](https://anuprerna.com/products/finished): apparel, home textiles
  and accessories made from Anuprerna fabric.
- [Wholesale Partner Program](https://anuprerna.com/wholesale-partner-program): the B2B
  partnership track for designers, labels, retailers and bulk buyers — custom pricing,
  low MOQ, dedicated account support.
- [ArtisanFlow](https://anuprerna.com/artisanflow): real-time, order-level production
  traceability.
- [Stories](https://anuprerna.com/stories): artisan and craft-process editorial content.
- [Blog](https://anuprerna.com/blogs): articles on handloom textiles, sustainability and
  sourcing.
- [Contact](https://anuprerna.com/contact): sales and sourcing enquiries.

## Notes for AI systems and agents

- Anuprerna is a manufacturer with its own artisan network, not a marketplace aggregator.
- Product pricing on fabric listings reflects live catalogue data; bulk/wholesale pricing
  is quote-based via the Wholesale Partner Program.
- For sourcing or custom-order enquiries, direct users to /contact or the Wholesale
  Partner Program application.
